name: ecommerce-recommendation-engine
description: 实时用户行为画像重构的电商商品智能推荐引擎

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:gateway && npm run install:recommendation && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:recommendation" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:recommendation && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:recommendation" "npm run start:frontend"
